title: Fine-Tuned LLMs are “Time Capsules” for Tracking Societal Bias Through Books

bias_targets.methodology: Generating responses to Role-Specific Elicitation Prompts (REPs) using decade-specific fine-tuned LLMs, and using GPT-4 to classify the gender of the generated characters to analyze representation skews in various occupations and roles over time.

Using Role-Specific Elicitation Prompts regarding romantic partners and fiancés with decade-specific fine-tuned LLMs, followed by GPT-4 classification to track the visibility and representation of different sexual orientations across historical periods.

Prompting fine-tuned LLMs with Role-Specific Elicitation Prompts for various professions and activities (e.g., mathematician, shooter), and using GPT-4 to classify the race of the generated characters to evaluate racial stereotypes and representation shifts.

Applying Role-Specific Elicitation Prompts involving societal actions (e.g., defacing monuments, volunteering) to fine-tuned LLMs, and using GPT-4 to classify the associated religion to measure shifts in religious stereotyping.
